messages:
Marta L: Heads up — Partner Emilia from Aurora Cloud reported intermittent NVML init errors on their marketplace image when using Aurora's signed driver overlay. Failing in their preflight CI on 8x A100 nodes. Ticket AUR-442 attached.
Jonas H: What stack? driver + CUDA + image tag?
Marta L: Aurora sent stack: driver 525.85, CUDA 12.2, marketplace image 'redwood-marketplace-gpu:gpu-2026-03-b', workload uses heavy batched generation (seq ~2048). Failures show `GPU has fallen off the bus` in dmesg.
Priya R: I'll spin a mirror cluster in our lab and try to repro with their driver overlay.
Ahmed K: I saw a similar pattern last week with a custom DKMS touch that changed module LTO flags. Might be a driver-module build mismatch with their kernel.
Emilia (partner-liaison): Aurora can try a hotpatch but prefers we coordinate a short maintenance window. They asked if Redwood can provide a rollback marketplace image while they iterate.
InfraBot: repro-job queued: aurora-repro-1739123456 on infra-lab-09 (ETA ~10m)
Jonas H: Quick triage plan: 1) repro in lab 2) driver bisect (520 -> 525 -> 530) 3) test CUDA12.1 fallback 4) prepare advisory if repro consistent.
Priya R: Repro: NVML init fails at ~38s. Command used:
```
docker run --gpus all --rm -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0-7 redwood-marketplace-gpu:gpu-2026-03-b python3 tests/harness.py --profile aurora
```
Jonas H: Starting bisect matrix for drivers 520.61, 525.85, 530.18.
InfraBot: matrix started: driver-bisect-1739123456
Jonas H: Bisect result — 525.85 reproduces the failure; 520.61 and 530.18 pass. Looks like a regression introduced in 525.x. I'll collect module build flags and kconfig diffs.
Ahmed K: CUDA12.1 smoke: with 525.85 + CUDA12.1 we don't hit NVML init failure in 15 runs, though memory pressure is elevated. So practical mitigations: a) pin runtime to CUDA12.1 for affected SKU b) produce image with driver 520 pinned c) partner-side rebuild without the suspicious DKMS option.
Marta L: For all three options we need partner signoff and a short roll plan. Sam, can we prepare a minimal compatibility advisory for Aurora and other SI customers?
Sam R (release-manager): I'll draft an advisory and a canary plan. Recommend emergency image with driver 520 and same CUDA12.2 so runtime change isn't necessary. Maintenance window proposed: tomorrow 02:00–05:00 UTC with 5% -> 25% canary.
Emilia (partner-liaison): Aurora OK with that window. They'll pause deployments and run canary telemetry.
Priya R: I'll produce repro artifacts and upload to s3://redwood-diagnostics/aurora/AUR-442/1739123456.tar.gz. Also will snapshot nvtop and dmesg.
Jonas H: I'll open a short vendor ticket recommending they review their DKMS flags, provide module build logs, and try a signed driver without the LTO flags.
Marta L: Action items in thread: - reproduce and collect logs (Priya) - bisect + module flags (Jonas) - run CUDA12.1 smoke (Ahmed) - draft advisory + schedule window (Sam) - partner coordination (Emilia).
Sam R (release-manager): Draft advisory: "We are aware of a compatibility issue affecting some marketplace GPU images when used with certain vendor driver overlays (525.85). A temporary marketplace patch image pinning driver to 520 is planned for a canary rollout tomorrow 02:00–05:00 UTC." Will circulate.
Marta L: Thanks. If any of you see new telemetry ping @here. :white_check_mark:
